title: Weather and Blue Hour
author: Quentin Vasquez
blurb: Jonah Hartwell, an heir cataloging a parent's silence after the funeral, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. Then a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must translate the untranslatable sentence and live with it, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
